questions.question_text: The cost of a job is $C=15n+40$. Make $n$ the subject.

options.why: Added 40 instead of subtracting it when undoing the $+40$.
Divided only the $C$ by 15; the whole numerator $C-40$ must be over 15.
Swapped the roles of 15 and 40, dividing by 40 instead of 15.

questions.question_text: The angle sum of a polygon is $S=180(n-2)$. Make $n$ the subject.

options.why: Subtracted 2, but undoing the $-2$ inside the bracket requires adding 2.
Subtracted 2 before dividing; the bracket must be cleared by dividing by 180 first.
Multiplied by 180 instead of dividing to undo the factor of 180.
Omitted the $\pm$; a squared subject has both a positive and a negative root.
Cleared the denominator but forgot to take the square root of $v^{2}$.
Divided by $r$ instead of multiplying both sides by $r$ to clear the fraction.
Divided by 3 instead of taking the cube root to undo the cube.
Took a square root, but undoing a cube needs a cube root.
